summary: STEPS is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master's in sustainable transportation and electrical power systems, led by the University of Oviedo with Kiel University, Sapienza University of Rome and the Polytechnic Institute of Coimbra. Full scholarships cover tuition and pay €1,400 a month for up to 24 months; others waive tuition only. The home page gives 8 January 2027 as the deadline.
meta_title: STEPS 2027: Erasmus Mundus electrical power systems master's
meta_description: STEPS pays tuition and €1,400 a month for a two-year master's in electrical power and transport in Spain, Germany, Italy or Portugal. Apply by 8 January 2027.
covers: Full scholarships: tuition fees plus €1,400 a month for up to 24 months.
Tuition fee waivers: tuition only. Self-funded students pay €4,500 a semester, €18,000 in total.
A joint degree after study on the Coimbra, Kiel and Oviedo track or the Rome, Kiel and Oviedo track.
eligibility: No nationality restriction, though no more than two scholarship holders may share a nationality.
A bachelor's degree in engineering of at least three years (180 ECTS). The programme's general information page asks for electrical engineering.
English at B2: IELTS 6.0 (no part below 5.5), TOEFL iBT 79 or PTE Academic 55, taken within two years of registration.
The automatic English waiver needs a degree taught entirely in English in a country on the UK's majority English-speaking list. Ghana and Nigeria are not on that list, so plan for a test.
how_to_apply: Apply online. Applications opened on 15 October 2026.

Upload a Europass CV, a motivation letter of no more than 250 words, signed reference letters, transcripts, your degree certificate (or a letter confirming your expected completion) and your passport. Documents not in English need a legalised or sworn translation.
Then post hard copies, stamped before the deadline.
Selection runs from 16 January to February 2027, and results with or without a scholarship come out in the second half of March.
watch_out: The programme's pages disagree on the deadline: the home page says 8 January 2027, the admission page 15 January. Apply by 8 January.
English certificates are accepted until 30 April, but a scholarship is easier to win with a complete file.
Scholarship holders must study full time and cannot hold another EU grant for the same course.
costs: Covered by a full scholarship or waiver
€1,400 a month for full scholarship holders

faq.q: When is the STEPS deadline for 2027?
faq.a: The programme's home page says 8 January 2027, while its admission page says 15 January. Submitting by 8 January is safe.
The University of Oviedo (Spain) leads, with Kiel University (Germany), Sapienza University of Rome (Italy) and the Polytechnic Institute of Coimbra (Portugal).
A bachelor's in engineering of at least 180 ECTS, ideally in electrical engineering.
